%doc: Source-of-truth manifest of the structured data Module:WearableSet stores in Bucket. Same entry shape as Module:Entity/properties.json; source names the processed value the module reads.

Name.desc: Set name (the page's subpage title when the name argument is absent).

Subject type.desc: The set's classification (Light armor, Racing suit, ...), the same value Entity pages carry as their structural type.

Image.desc: Infobox image filename without the File: prefix, the value PageImages picks as the page image.

Manufacturer.desc: Manufacturer page; absent for UNKN and NONE.

Type.desc: Set type: Armor set, Flight suit, Undersuit.

Classification.desc: Light armor, Medium armor, Heavy armor, Racing suit, Armored flight suit, ...

Minimum temperature.desc: Lowest survivable temperature across the set's pieces (the highest of the pieces' minimums).

Maximum temperature.desc: Highest survivable temperature across the set's pieces (the lowest of the pieces' maximums).

Radiation.desc: Lowest radiation capacity among the pieces.

Radiation scrub rate.desc: Lowest radiation dissipation rate among the pieces.

G Resistance.desc: Summed G-force resistance of undersuit and arm and leg pieces.
